4.
(1) Any person who-

(a)
commits an offence under section 3 with the
intention to cause death, and causes the death
of  any  other  person  in  the  course  of
committing  such  offence,  shall,  upon
conviction  by  the  High  Court  be  punished
with life imprisonment;

(b)
commits an offence under section 3 and causes
the death of any other person in the course of
committing  such  offence,  of  which  the
reasonable  foreseeable  consequence  is  the
death  of  any  other  person,  shall,  upon
conviction  by  the  High  Court  be  punished
with  imprisonment  for  a  period  which  may
extend to life imprisonment; or

(c)
commits  an  offence    under  section  3  other
than the offences referred to in paragraph (a)
and  (b),  shall  upon  conviction  by  the  High
Court  be  liable  to  imprisonment  of  either
description for a term not exceeding twenty
years and to a fine not exceeding rupees one
million.
